gloss: to roast, to parch, to toast (dry heat)

definitions.gloss: to roast, to parch, to toast (dry heat)
definitions.explanation: To cook something using dry heat without oil, typically in a pan or over direct heat. Used for beans, seeds, nuts, and similar ingredients.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大豆|だいず}→大豆：10536_daizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦フライパン→フライパン：01025_furaipan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{炒|い}って⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please roast the soybeans in a frying pan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{節分|せつぶん}→節分：18971_setsubun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{炒|い}った⟦{大豆|だいず}→大豆：10536_daizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{数|かず}→数：00204_kazu⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦{風習|ふうしゅう}→風習：05826_fuushuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a custom of eating roasted soybeans equal to one's age on Setsubun.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧). No intransitive pair.

WRITING:
Also written ⟦{煎|い}る→煎る：16887_iru⟧. Both kanji are used, though {炒|い}る is more common for dry-roasting in a pan.

DISTINCTION FROM {炒|いた}める:
{炒|い}る refers to dry roasting without oil (seeds, beans, tea leaves), while ⟦{炒|いた}める→炒める：01879_itameru⟧ means to stir-fry with oil (vegetables, meat). This distinction is important in cooking contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ごま⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{炒|い}る: to roast sesame seeds
- ⟦{豆|まめ}→豆：03738_mame⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{炒|い}る: to roast beans
- ⟦コーヒー{豆|まめ}→コーヒー豆：25759_koohiimame⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{炒|い}る: to roast coffee beans
